title: kube-oidc-proxy LDAP configuration
description: LDAP membership lookup and per-user ConfigMap cache configuration.

backends.description: Query every backend for each uncached identity and union complete successful results.

refreshInterval.description: How often the elected leader refreshes cached users.

refreshUsers.description: Users allowed to call the stub refresh endpoint. Matched case insensitively, with or without the OIDC username prefix. If unset, any authenticated user may call it.

lookupTimeout.description: Total time for one admitted lookup, including Kubernetes reads, LDAP and persistence.

lookupConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent distinct-user lookups started by requests per replica, including Kubernetes reads, LDAP and persistence. New identities are rejected when full; existing calls can still be joined. Each LDAP lookup queries all backends.

refreshConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent lookups started by the leader's periodic refresh, counted separately from lookupConcurrency so a refresh cycle never exhausts request capacity.

name.description: Name of the backend. Used in logs, statistics and errors, and must be unique.

urls.description: URL(s) of this directory. Tried in order until one can be connected to and bound.

bindDN.description: DN to bind to the directory as. If unset, an anonymous bind is used.

bindPassword.description: Password to bind with. Prefer bindPasswordFile to keep the password out of the config file.

bindPasswordFile.description: File holding the password to bind with.

caFile.description: PEM encoded certificate authority bundle used to verify the serving certificate of this directory. Defaults to the host trust store.

insecureSkipTLSVerify.description: Do not verify the serving certificate of this directory. Insecure, and intended for testing only.

startTLS.description: Issue a StartTLS request after connecting. Used with an 'ldap://' URL to upgrade the connection to TLS.

timeout.description: Bound connecting, binding and searching this backend for one user.

userSearchBases.description: Base DN(s) to search for users under.

usernameAttribute.description: Attribute of a user entry holding the name that matches the username of the token. Matched case insensitively.

groupSearchBases.description: Base DN(s) to search for groups under. Only groups under these bases contribute memberships.

groupNameAttribute.description: Full emitted group name attribute; must be unique within the backend.
